disputes.reason: Concentration risk is commonly understood to include industry-wide systemic risk; whether it does depends on one unidentified report's footnote, so a student cannot judge the card and could reasonably argue it true.
'All four Irish banks' depends on the question's scenario (which four banks); the 2010 CEBS test did not cover the same four, so the statement is unanchored and cannot be judged standalone.

Ambiguous: if the same total losses are spread over a longer horizon, more pre-provision earnings accrue and the test can be easier; the explanation instead assumes a longer horizon accumulates more losses, contradicting the 'same losses' premise.
